SELECT distinct base99.*, dani99.belong_institution_code belongInstitutionCode, dani99.model_type modelType FROM(
select fpd.finprod_id finprodId, fpd.finprod_abbr finprodAbbr, fpd.finprod_name finprodName, fpd.FINPROD_TYPE finprodType, fpd.profit_type profitType, fpd.coupon_species couponSpecies, fpd.chl_finprod_id chlFinprodId, fpd.finprod_market_id finprodMarketId, nvl(fpd.issue_price, 0) issuePrice, nvl(fpd.issue_amt, 0) issueAmt, fpd.CCY ccy, fpd.bln_area blnArea, fpd.bln_area blnAreaCode, fpd.trade_market tradeMarket, fpd.trade_market tradeMarketCode, fpd.issue_type issueType, fpd.issuer, to_char(fpd.idate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') idateStr, to_char(fpd.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vdateStr, to_char(fpd.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mdateStr, to_char(fpd.actmdate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') actmdateStr, fpd.is_chl isChl, fpd.is_sus isSus, fpd.is_right isRight, fpd.p_finprod_id pFinprodId, fpd.o_finprod_id oFinprodId, ofpd.finprod_type oFinprodType from FIN_PRODUCT fpd left join FIN_PRODUCT ofpd on ofpd.finprod_id = fpd.finprod_id where 1 = 1
and fpd.finprod_type not in ('F01','F06','F10')
AND fpd.finprod_Id LIKE '%'||#{finprodId}||'%'
AND fpd.FINPROD_TYPE in
#{finprodType}
AND (fpd.finprod_abbr LIKE '%'||#{finprodName}||'%' or fpd.finprod_name LIKE '%'||#{finprodName}||'%')
AND fpd.VDATE >= to_date(#{vDateBegin},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND fpd.VDATE <= to_date(#{vDateEnd},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND fpd.mDate >= to_date(#{mDateBegin},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND fpd.mDate <= to_date(#{mDateEnd},'yyyy-MM-dd')
union select ftr.finprod_id finprodId, null, null, ftr.FINPROD_TYPE finprodType, null, null, ftr.CHL_AGRT_ID chlFinprodId, null, 0, 0, ftr.CCY ccy, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, to_char(ftr.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vdateStr, to_char(ftr.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mdateStr, null, null, null, null, null, ftr.o_finprod_id oFinprodId, oftp.finprod_type oFinprodType from FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT ftr left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT oftp on oftp.finprod_id = ftr.finprod_id and nvl(ftr.branch,0) = 0 where 1 = 1 and (ftr.branch_type is null and ftr.branch = '0') /**过滤掉计划类资产，利息结转交易作为标的信息插入该表，只统计接口接进来的标的信息。【杭州uat:HZ-UAT-134】**/ and ftr.finprod_id not in (select finprod_id from FIN_PRODUCT)
AND ftr.finprod_Id LIKE '%'||#{finprodId}||'%'
AND ftr.FINPROD_TYPE in
#{finprodType}
AND ftr.finprod_id not in (select finprod_id from FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT)
AND ftr.VDATE >= to_date(#{vDateBegin},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND ftr.VDATE <= to_date(#{vDateEnd},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND ftr.mDate >= to_date(#{mDateBegin},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND ftr.mDate <= to_date(#{mDateEnd},'yyyy-MM-dd')
) base99 INNER JOIN data_auth_notify_inst dani99 ON dani99.BUSINESS_ID = base99.finprodId AND dani99.MODEL_TYPE = '02' WHERE dani99.institution_code IN
#{item}
union select fpd.finprod_id finprodId, fpd.finprod_abbr finprodAbbr, fpd.finprod_name finprodName, fpd.FINPROD_TYPE finprodType, fpd.profit_type profitType, fpd.coupon_species couponSpecies, fpd.chl_finprod_id chlFinprodId, fpd.finprod_market_id finprodMarketId, nvl(fpd.issue_price, 0) issuePrice, nvl(fpd.issue_amt, 0) issueAmt, fpd.CCY ccy, fpd.bln_area blnArea, fpd.bln_area blnAreaCode, fpd.trade_market tradeMarket, fpd.trade_market tradeMarketCode, fpd.issue_type issueType, fpd.issuer, to_char(fpd.idate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') idateStr, to_char(fpd.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vdateStr, to_char(fpd.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mdateStr, to_char(fpd.actmdate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') actmdateStr, fpd.is_chl isChl, fpd.is_sus isSus, fpd.is_right isRight, fpd.p_finprod_id pFinprodId, fpd.o_finprod_id oFinprodId, ofpd.finprod_type oFinprodType ,'' belongInstitutionCode, '01' modelType from FIN_PRODUCT fpd left join FIN_PRODUCT ofpd on ofpd.finprod_id = fpd.finprod_id where 1 = 1 and fpd.finprod_type in ('F01','F06','F10')
AND fpd.finprod_Id LIKE '%'||#{finprodId}||'%'
AND fpd.FINPROD_TYPE in
#{finprodType}
AND (fpd.finprod_abbr LIKE '%'||#{finprodName}||'%' or fpd.finprod_name LIKE '%'||#{finprodName}||'%')
AND fpd.VDATE >= to_date(#{vDateBegin},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND fpd.VDATE <= to_date(#{vDateEnd},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND fpd.mDate >= to_date(#{mDateBegin},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND fpd.mDate <= to_date(#{mDateEnd},'yyyy-MM-dd')
